name: not-ai
description: Rewrite prose so it reads like a person wrote it. Uses PNAS 2025 research on morphosyntactic features to target the structural layer: clause types, sentence burstiness, nominalization density, epistemic stance. Includes deterministic Python measurement scripts, 8 genre profiles, and a pre-output gate with counted values.

interface.shortDescription: Prose that reads like a person wrote it. Research-backed structural rewriting.
interface.longDescription: The only humanizer based on peer-reviewed linguistics research (PNAS 2025). Targets clause type distribution, sentence burstiness, nominalization density, and epistemic stance instead of swapping banned words. Includes Python measurement scripts that count structural features before rewriting. 8 genre profiles. Pre-output gate with counted values. Never fabricates facts.
capabilities: Rewrite AI-sounding prose by restructuring clauses, not swapping words
Measure structural features with deterministic Python scripts before rewriting
Adapt to 8 genres: LinkedIn, academic, technical, email, README, social, fiction, personal essay
Write from scratch that avoids generated-text patterns from the start
Diagnose which structural patterns make a passage read as AI
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this so it does not sound like AI
